summary: Explains how to define and manage the various sources from which admission leads originate, such as direct walk-ins, online advertisements, or third-party integrations, and how to enable reference tracking.
steps: Navigate to Admission Module > Admission Setup > Admission Master.
Click "Add New Details" to add a new lead source.
Enter the "Source Name" (e.g., "Direct Walk-in", "Newspaper Ad", "Google Ad", "Website", "College Duniya").
Optionally, toggle on "Reference Source" if the lead source involves a referral.
business_rules: Enabling the "Reference Source" option will add additional fields for capturing reference details when a lead is being added.
important_notes: Accurate tracking of lead sources is essential for analyzing the effectiveness of different marketing and outreach efforts.
questions: How do I add new lead sources in the Admission module?
What is the purpose of the "Reference Source" option when setting up lead sources?
Can I track leads coming from online ads or third-party platforms?
Where do I define the origin of an admission inquiry?
